promptRecord: Production brief reconstructed from the authored requirements; this is not a verbatim archive of tool prompts.
commonBrief: Create one transparent horizontal four-frame work-animation strip of the referenced MUGONG NPC. Hand-painted chibi wuxia, elevated three-quarter camera, consistent identity, anatomy, proportions, camera and lighting. Four equal cells with complete silhouettes and generous transparent padding. Keep body size and feet baseline constant; no text, background, floor, UI, glow or watermark. Anticipation, preparation, work contact, recovery. Tools stay attached to the correct hands, with anatomically credible joints.
processing: Generated RGBA PNGs copied byte-for-byte to public. No raster editing, resizing or background stripping. Renderer uses explicit source rectangles and per-frame foot origins with a single fixed body scale per NPC.

review: All generated strips inspected, then actual in-game normal/reduced work paths captured. Merchant raw frames drift horizontally; explicit foot anchors in src/game/waystation-work.ts compensate without body deformation. Existing idle sprites remain outside work and on loading failure. SHA256 and sizes are recorded in asset-manifest.json. No claim of all animation state combinations reviewed.
